Job Description:

Painting of surfaces according to the valid quality and production regulations also in the synchronous coating process.

Preparatory work (preparation of tools and materials, cleaning, masking, masking, grinding, activating) and color preparation (manual / with installation and documentation).

Preparation and application of technical signposting.

Prepare and apply the decora using different application techniques.

This job requires an awareness of any potential compliance risks and a commitment to act with integrity, as the foundation for the Company’s success, reputation and sustainable growth.
